notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview — Pet Skill is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players:

Following pet reborn and absorption, the pet system is about to usher in another major update: the opening of pet skills. The opening of new pet skills is aimed at enhancing the value of pet training and its combat effectiveness, making pets a more powerful assistant on your adventure journey! The following is a preview of the features for you:

(The following is a display of the test server experience content, the final online version shall prevail)

[Unlock Pet Skill Column]
When the pet level reaches Lv4/Lv6/Lv8, 3 additional columns of the skill talent column can be unlocked respectively. When at least 1 additional column is unlocked, the "Skill comprehend" operation can be done. If no additional column is unlocked, the "Skill comprehend" operation cannot be done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/f9d985b641f537bf494746dc5b275d45128147b3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/ce7b4af9e3ce80ac33934b8aec751c963ae10f4c.png

[Skills to Learn & Upgrade]
In the "Pet/Pet Skills" interface, players can view the skills that can be comprehended/upgraded for the selected pet; the number of skills that can be comprehended for pets of different qualities is also different. The first version is tentatively open to the learning of skills for pets below epic quality:

Ordinary  → up to 4 skills to comprehend
Excellent  → up to 9 skills to comprehend
Rare  → up to 16 skills to comprehend

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/fae188836084ac76a8e12c752884a99b98849e15.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/fce02c841a563616eac5591fa105e30a64ef3b5e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/95275d5eae6933f5e28bad69f426397f0c2f2384.png

It should be pointed out here that the skills of pets of the same quality will be obtained randomly from the skill library, and there is a certain probability of obtaining rare skills. For example, two identical black wind wolves may have different skills to learn. The rich skill library adds more fun to your pet exploration and development.

After selecting a pet, click "Comprehend" on the pet skill interface to consume a certain amount of gold coins, and you can randomly obtain a skill from the pet's skill pool and randomly add it to a skill column (if the skill column is already filled with skills, you can choose to replace the position.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/9c1df5ae55d70c7c1e34b0ee5d2fe6f85d75528c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/5fb8d80571c5de27eaa37a2c6ce31392490f0790.png

Select a pet to view the skill status in the pet's skill pool. The skill icon has two states: highlighted and grayed out. Grayed out means unlearned skills, and highlighted means learned skills. Players can consume a certain number of designated props to upgrade learned skills. Higher-level skills will bring more powerful effects. We will also gradually open up the output and drop of upgrade props in subsequent gameplay and activities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/7669de8033d0fbc91d8daa40664c2f7137f3c2e9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/62fc784946aee9a7d41997647fd1137509f29a1e.png

New changes brought by the opening of pet skills
☆ Improve the value of cultivation: As the pet level increases, more pet skills are brought;
☆ Improve pet potential: A rich skill library brings more possibilities for improving pet potential;
☆ More skill experience: More new skills add more fun to adventure battles;

The opening of pet skills is a major change that will bring a further leap in the combat effectiveness of pets. At the same time, the rich pet skills also bring unlimited possibilities for pet training. Please pay attention to the subsequent announcements on our official platform for more update details and launch time.

notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview — Pet Island is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

The brand-new [Pet Island] is about to arrive! This mysterious island is filled with rare resources and untold challenges, awaiting all tamers to explore. Below are the key details to know its core mechanics!

​​[Highlights at a Glance]​​
Unlock Requirements: Reach Level ≥20 and unlock the Pet System, then access Pet Island via the World Teleportation Portal!
​​Solo PVE Adventure: Freely explore a shared multiplayer map with independent resource nodes—no competition, just peaceful gathering!
​​Strategy Meets Surprise: Trigger random events—either claim treasures instantly or battle powerful monsters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b568955a5dd88ba88b2ab56c0be8f1ab0b051b81.png

[Core Gameplay in 3 Steps]​
​​①Click to Collect Random Encounters
Monsters will spawn randomly across Pet Island. Tap them to start gathering!
Two outcomes may occur:
​​Instant Rewards: Collect materials without combat!
​​Enter Combat: Defeat the monster to claim rare resources!
②Treasure Trove of Resources – Three Key Resources Guaranteed from Gathering
Basic Resources (Guaranteed Drops)​​
Silver: Universal currency for enhancing equipment and enchanting cards.
​​Pet Food Fragments: Synthesize a specific number to craft exclusive pet food and unlock pet skills.
​​Pet Essence: Redeem various rewards in the Pet Island Store to swiftly cultivate your pets.
​​③Daily Attempts, Flexible Planning​​
Default daily attempts: 5. Once exhausted:
​​Wait for Reset: Free attempts refresh daily!
​​Expand with Gold: Spend gold to instantly increase attempts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/c46b7c3322d1e180bc15c86e0364bf3ba3453f0c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/e476764aea30351dbae48ca737c6b606302bd8ab.png

​​[Optimization Details]​​
Seamless Map Experience: All players are displayed on the same screen for lively immersion, but resources are calculated individually—pure solo adventure!
​​Visual Status Updates:
​​Countdown Timer: Visible when attempts remain. Nodes reset to grayed-out positions after use. Locked Nodes: Fully consumed attempts lock nodes until daily refresh!
​​Interaction Priority: Overlapping players trigger collection first—no more accidental misclicks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/82a5f21e71d0df6ee2b54e3cc40401e36d06fe91.png

Pet Island is designed as an immersive growth space for all players, blending casual play and thrilling challenges. Whether you’re a casual collector or a combat enthusiast, there’s something for everyone! Future updates will introduce exchange shops and crossover events to enrich your experience.
Stay tuned to our official platforms for release dates and more details. See you on the island!

——《火焰征程》Operations Team

(Note: This preview reflects a work-in-progress version. Final rules are subject to in-game implementation.)

notes.title: “火焰征程” Fashion Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

  We are thrilled to announce that 火焰征程 is about to bring you a major and highly anticipated update—the Fashion System!
  The Fashion System is designed to offer players a wide range of character appearance customization options. With fashion, your character can have a cool and unique style, featuring various themed outfits including holiday, tech, fantasy, and more!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/4f4c2b321ddd1d55a121f2fa05c91d0b7ce2cfb0.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/91217bed54f33deea8f4497c6ff8d6c7397a3b55.gif
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
 Fashion items come with both time-limited and permanent durations. Once obtained, they can be equipped from the "Character" tab in your backpack. Fashion items are categorized into five tiers based on quality: Exquisite, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Unprecedented. Players can obtain fashion items of various quality levels through different channels. The higher the fashion tier, the richer the special effects and higher the attributes. Fashion items can also be linked with your equipped mount, adding unique features to your beloved steed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/990b967cbc844996fda781f316628a2c00e1399c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/a9ac0ce6ef6a8a4ca35ed94e64d26be12a20f99c.gif
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
What’s even more exciting is that fashion comes with attribute bonuses, boosting stats such as health, block, and critical strike, helping you dominate the battlefield. Experience a whole new style of combat today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/a3a1ae9c0fd0b9aef775ddecf6c5083ce91959d6.png
  That’s all for today's preview of the new content. We believe these new features will bring you a more enriched and enjoyable gaming experience. Please stay tuned for further announcements on our official platforms to learn more about the update details and release time.
  Thank you for your ongoing support and love for 火焰征程! We look forward to seeing you discover more exciting content in the new version and enjoy the fresh gaming experience!

notes.title: 《火焰征程》Version Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The World Scene, which was mentioned in the August version revelation of 《火焰征程》, will be available to all players on October 15, 2024 after the update! As a brand new game scene, the main purpose of [World Scene] is to strengthen the communication between players and show their style, and we are going to learn more about the details and the update plan from Q4 2024 to Q4 2025.

Warm tips: The following are all test servers or art effect displays. The final effect is subject to the official online version. The《火焰征程》team has the final right of interpretation.

1. Update of [World Scene]

Players can enter or leave the world scene by clicking the [World][Inner City] button in the main city scene of the game.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/3d020f79034c19b999fc6e1dd9521a02b569ee48.gif

In addition, players who enter the scene can walk around freely. If the player is carrying a pet, the pet will also follow.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/0969d036aac34e7465ca6f44c790e92c8dd28bf8.gif

In the world scene, players' chat messages will not only be displayed in the chat box, but also on the avatars of the characters in the scene with the effect of chat message bubbles.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/be4688adaea825f4890b4d5c3d4029faa0cc2dbf.gif

As the first version of the world scene, the design and development team will try to improve the players' experience as much as possible under the premise of ensuring stability. We will also gradually enrich the supporting functions of the world scene in the subsequent version updates to further enhance the player experience.

2.More Updates Preview

We expect to launch more updates and optimizations aimed at improving the fun and experience of the game from the end of 2024 to 2025. The following is the planning of some content.

【Q4, 2024】
①**Pet System**
Open pet reborn & new skill talents. The opening of new functions is to make pets more growth-oriented and avoid the waste of training resources. At the same time, new skills will also make your favorite pets more powerful.
②**World Scene Honor Display**
Players with special honors will get a special display position in the world scene to show their status.

【Q1-Q2, 2025】
①**Mount System**
The new mount system will not only be limited to battles, but will also show other players your cool mounts in more scenes including the world.
②**Title System**
Players can obtain titles and show their unique charm in different scene.
③**Fashion System**
Different fashion combinations will be reflected in the game, especially in the world scene, it will no longer be a stereotyped "professional outfit".

【Q3-Q4, 2025】
①**Pet Island**
②**Resource Battle**

【Ongoing】
**Art Quality Iteration**

In addition, we will continue to iterate and optimize the art quality. Whether it's the game scenes or the character models of the cards, we will continue to optimize this aspect.

We have not done it perfectly along the way, but we will always keep a player-first heart and continue to enrich and optimize the game content. We also welcome players to give feedback and communicate on our plans. Thank you for your support along the way.

Dear players,
We are very happy to announce that "火焰征程" will bring you a series of exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. The following are the main contents of the new features:
1. New version of novice guide
Monologue Episode A new monologue will be added to the new guide, centered around the protagonist investigating the mysterious disappearance of an explorer during his quest. This episode will reveal more of the backstory and mission objectives, making the start of your game even more intriguing.

Icon guidance and character movement function In order to help players better explore the game world, we have introduced icon guidance and character movement functions to make the game scenes more vivid and real. With the movement of the game characters, you can not only see the dynamic movement of the characters in various scenes, but this function will also provide players with clear navigation guidance, so that you can find mission objectives and important scenes more easily.

World function display The newly added "World" entrance will become an important window for you to understand the game world. "World" not only includes the original character movement function in the novice tutorial, but also allows you to see the explorers' waiting screen in the main city and the display scene of the top three explorers' glory moments.
